# Boss Encounter, AI Fairness & Anti-Exploit Requirements Quality Checklist: Dungeons & Bosses

**Purpose**: Đánh giá chất lượng, độ đầy đủ, tính nhất quán dữ liệu và khả năng chống khai thác lỗi trong các yêu cầu của tính năng `011-dungeon-boss` (Dungeon Instances, 10-State Monster AI, 5 Multi-Phase Bosses, Stagger, Enrage, Rewards).
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all 10 Monster AI FSM states (`IDLE` through `RESPAWN`), their exact override priority hierarchy, and the `1024 px` sleeping optimization explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all six `targetPriority` modes, Tank threat scaling (`1.6x`), Taunt override (`3.0x` / `4.0s`), zero overheal threat, and melee/ranged hysteresis (`+10%` / `+20%`) fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all boss encounter lifecycle rules (5s entry lock, `allowLateJoin: false`, 1–4 player scaling lock, safe pillar interaction, environmental hazards, Poise break, Enrage, 2-revive cap, full wipe reset) completely covered? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK004 Are both MVP (`dng_mossroot_hollow` / `boss_thornback_elder`, `8` Regular + `1` Elite) and post-MVP (`4` dungeons/bosses including 4-phase `boss_malakor_abyss`, `30` Regular + `8` Elite) boundaries unambiguously documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK005 Do all `boss_thornback_elder` numerical requirements (`100%/65%/30%` phases, `6.0s` Poise break, `x1.40` damage taken, `x1.50` FIRE Poise bonus, `360s` Enrage, `1.00x..3.10x` HP scaling) match `game-data/bosses.json` with zero drift? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK006 Are pathfinding CPU bounds (`<= 120` nodes, `3/s` repath, `28 px` separation, `1.5s`/`3.0s` stuck recovery) and ground telegraph rendering rules (`180–199` unlit layer, colorblind geometry, never obscured by Ultimate VFX) objectively defined? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-007, Constitution §V]
- [ ] CHK007 Are fair reward lockouts (`>= 5%` contribution, immutable account-level `First Clear` `STARLIGHT_SHARD`, weekly UTC Monday `00:00` reset, `BOSS_TOKEN` weekly cap, `15m` cooldown, full-bag overflow to `bld_storage`) unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Consistency & Constitution Alignment

- [ ] CHK008 Are runtime simulation entities (`DungeonInstance`, AI FSM, Threat Table, Boss Phase) strictly kept in RAM with zero per-tick disk I/O while durable lockouts and Elite respawn timers persist solely to local JSON files (`data/db/`)? [Consistency, Constitution §I, Constitution §IV]
- [ ] CHK009 Are all hit detection, telegraph execution timestamps, pillar destruction states, and reward distributions strictly server-authoritative without accepting client combat outcomes? [Consistency, Constitution §II]

## Edge Cases, Anti-Exploit & Resilience Coverage

- [ ] CHK010 Are anti-exploit requirements explicitly defined for out-of-arena projectiles after `5s` lock, terrain-stuck safespotting (`2s` ranged fallback), disconnect scaling manipulation, summoned minion farming (`max 2`, `30s` TTL, `yieldsLoot = false`), and Phase-4 burst skipping (`15%` HP lock for `1.5s`)? [Security, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Are server restart recovery requirements specified for persisting world Elite respawn timers (`data/db/world/<regionId>.json`) and cleaning up empty/completed `DungeonInstance` memory (`120s` / `300s`)? [Recovery, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the AI CPU target (`< 6 ms` per `50 ms` tick for `60` active mobs) transparently tagged as `proposed / unverified` without fabricating benchmark claims? [Honesty, Spec §SC-005, Constitution §VIII]
